name: Scorching Ray

targets.description: three rays aimed at one target or split among several

summary: Three fiery rays, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 Fire. One more ray per slot level above 2.
text: You hurl three rays of fire at one target within range or split them among several. Make a separate ranged spell attack for each ray; each hit deals 2d6 Fire damage. You create one more ray for each spell slot level above 2.
